findings.summary: Exact package/STARTED binding, target-blind raw preservation, independent digest re-fetch, post-preservation target materialization, fail-closed scorer joins, and immutable evidence tag are consistent with the frozen contract.
Observed primary BREU effect is +0.10044748325412106 with registered pair-bootstrap 95% CI [0.09457740578201118, 0.10647303483001931], yielding formal PASS under the frozen rule.

The scorer resamples 1,744 pair indices independently, while Belief-R pair construction groups/reuses structure by (atomic_idx, modus) and the official dataset has atomic_idx 0-596; pair-level independence is not established, so the tight CI may be anti-conservative for generalization across reasoning families.
Terminal evidence explicitly forbids winner claims for unmatched descriptive baselines and limits the result to truth-free surface structural representation gain.
